title: Train nested embedding prefixes
prompt: Average diagonal-positive in-batch retrieval cross-entropy across independently normalized embedding prefixes. Inputs have equal [B,D] shape and widths are positive <=D. Return scalar Matryoshka-style training loss; cross-example duplicates need a different positive mask.
